title: Nebius leases AI capacity at Vantage's Newport, Wales campus

sources.quote: Under the agreement, Nebius will lease high-density capacity at CWL1 to support AI training, inference, agentic AI and enterprise AI workloads, serving enterprises, researchers, startups and public sector organizations seeking access to advanced AI infrastructure.

explain: AI cloud company Nebius agreed to lease high-density capacity at Vantage's CWL1 campus in Newport, Wales, for Nvidia-based AI servers. Size and value were not disclosed.
